title: Basic Customer Support Call
description: A script for a basic customer support call in English.

steps.customer: Hello, I need help with my internet connection.
steps.translation: Olá, preciso de ajuda com minha conexão de internet.

steps.customer: My internet is down and I can't access any websites.
steps.translation: Minha internet está fora do ar e não consigo acessar nenhum site.

steps.customer: I have tried restarting my router, but it didn't work.
steps.translation: Eu tentei reiniciar meu roteador, mas não funcionou.

steps.customer: I need to reset my password, can you help me with that?
steps.translation: Preciso redefinir minha senha, você pode me ajudar com isso?

steps.customer: I forgot my password and I can't log in to my account.
steps.translation: Esqueci minha senha e não consigo entrar na minha conta.

steps.customer: Thank you for your help, I appreciate it.
steps.translation: Obrigado pela sua ajuda, eu aprecio.
